We need to find $\lim_{x\rightarrow+\infty}\left[\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}\right]^x$.

Let me compute the logarithm:
$$\ln L = \lim_{x\to+\infty} x \ln \frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}$$

$$= \lim_{x\to+\infty} x \left[n\ln x - \sum_{k=1}^n \ln(x-k)\right]$$

$$= \lim_{x\to+\infty} x \sum_{k=1}^n \left[\ln x - \ln(x-k)\right]$$

$$= \lim_{x\to+\infty} x \sum_{k=1}^n \ln\frac{x}{x-k}$$

$$= \lim_{x\to+\infty} x \sum_{k=1}^n \ln\frac{1}{1-k/x}$$

$$= \lim_{x\to+\infty} x \sum_{k=1}^n \left[\frac{k}{x} + \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{k}{x}\right)^2 + O(1/x^3)\right]$$

$$= \lim_{x\to+\infty} x \left[\frac{1}{x}\sum_{k=1}^n k + \frac{1}{2x^2}\sum_{k=1}^n k^2 + O(1/x^3)\right]$$

$$= \lim_{x\to+\infty} \left[\sum_{k=1}^n k + \frac{1}{2x}\sum_{k=1}^n k^2 + O(1/x^2)\right]$$

$$= \frac{n(n+1)}{2}$$

So $L = e^{n(n+1)/2}$.
